description: A four-panel composite figure made entirely of bar-type plots that together quantify the heterogeneous grain architecture of Fe-Mn-Al-C steels with different Zr additions. (a) is a grouped bar chart with y-axis "Fraction (%)" spanning 0-100 and x-axis categorical labels Zr0, Zr0.01, Zr0.50; the legend distinguishes "Coarse grain" (grey bars) from "Fine grain" (blue bars). The coarse-grain fraction drops from a full 100% for Zr0 to just above 90% for Zr0.01 and near 65% for Zr0.50, while the fine-grain fraction appears only as a small bar (~7%) in Zr0.01 and grows to roughly 35% in Zr0.50. (b)-(d) are grain-size histograms of FCC grains for Zr0, Zr0.01 and Zr0.50 respectively, y-axis "Fraction" (0.00-0.18 in b and c, 0.00-0.15 in d) versus x-axis "Grain size (μm)" covering 0-25 (b), 0-20 (c) and 0-15 (d). (b) is unimodal with the tallest bar just above 0.15 near 11 μm; (c) is unimodal but shifted left, peaking near 5-6 μm; (d) is clearly bimodal, with one mode near 2.5-3 μm and a second near 5 μm. No numeric data labels are printed on any bar. The panels jointly demonstrate that increasing Zr refines the FCC grains and converts a homogeneous structure into a bimodal coarse-grain/fine-grain heterostructure.
measured_quantities: area fraction of coarse-grain and fine-grain zones (%)
average FCC grain size (μm, cited from text not printed on the figure)

observations.observation: Panel (a) legend contains exactly two entries, grey 'Coarse grain' and blue 'Fine grain', each labelled in percent fraction on the y-axis.
In panel (a) the Zr0 steel shows a coarse-grain bar reaching the 100% gridline and no visible fine-grain bar.
In panel (a) the Zr0.01 steel shows a coarse-grain bar just above the 90% gridline and a small fine-grain bar well below 10%.
In panel (a) the Zr0.50 steel shows a coarse-grain bar between the 60 and 70% gridlines and a fine-grain bar between the 30 and 40% gridlines (about 35%).
Panel (b) for Zr0 is unimodal with the tallest bar between 0.15 and 0.18 on the Fraction axis, located between the 10 and 15 μm ticks (near 11 μm).
Panel (c) for Zr0.01 peaks between the 5 and 10 μm ticks, with the tallest bar near 0.14 Fraction, and shows a tail out to about 17 μm.

Panel (d) for Zr0.50 is clearly bimodal: one mode peaks between the 0 and 5 μm ticks (near 2.5-3 μm, ~0.11-0.115 Fraction) and a second lower mode appears near 5 μm (~0.085), with the x-axis ending at 15 μm.
No numeric data labels are printed on any bar in any of the four panels; all values must be read against the axis gridlines.

The caption states that (a) gives the area fraction of FG and CG zones in Zr0, Zr0.01 and Zr0.50 steels, and that (b)-(d) give the grain size distribution of FCC grains in Zr0, Zr0.01 and Zr0.50 steels, respectively.
The citing text states that the fraction of fine grains increases from 0% to 35% as Zr content rises from 0 wt% to 0.50 wt%.
The citing text states the average FCC grain size decreases from 12 μm to 7 μm when 0.01 wt% Zr is added.
The citing text states that further Zr addition (Zr0.50 steel) produces a bimodal FCC grain distribution of 5 μm and 1 μm, in contrast to the homogeneous grains of Zr0 and Zr0.01 steel.

subfigures.description: Grouped bar chart of zone area fraction: y-axis 'Fraction (%)' (0-100), x-axis categories Zr0, Zr0.01, Zr0.50; legend 'Coarse grain' (grey) and 'Fine grain' (blue). Coarse grain ~100% (Zr0), ~93% (Zr0.01), ~65% (Zr0.50); fine grain ~0%, ~7%, ~35% respectively.

Grain-size histogram labelled Zr0: y-axis 'Fraction' (0.00-0.18), x-axis 'Grain size (μm)' (0-25). Single unimodal distribution with the tallest bar slightly above 0.15 at about 11 μm, plus small bars out to ~23 μm.

Grain-size histogram labelled Zr0.01: y-axis 'Fraction' (0.00-0.18), x-axis 'Grain size (μm)' (0-20). Unimodal distribution shifted to smaller size, peak bar ~0.14 at about 5-6 μm, tail extending to ~17 μm.

Grain-size histogram labelled Zr0.50: y-axis 'Fraction' (0.00-0.15), x-axis 'Grain size (μm)' (0-15). Bimodal distribution with a first mode peaking near 2.5-3 μm (~0.11-0.115) and a second, lower mode near 5 μm (~0.085), tail to ~14 μm.

unreadable_items: No numeric values are printed on the bars of panels (a)-(d); only gridline-level readings are possible.
Panels (b)-(d) x-axis bin widths are not labelled, so individual histogram bin centres cannot be stated exactly.
